title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds request logging to improve debugging and error tracking, providing valuable insights into application performance and potential issues, while also handling edge cases and errors to ensure robustness
testCases: Test logging for failed requests with error handling
acceptance: Request logs are written to a file or console with relevant information, including request method, path, and response status code, and error handling is triggered for failed requests
reason: Enhances debugging capabilities, improves error tracking, and increases overall system reliability
